mapper.insert: INSERT INTO manager_login_10m_stats (window_start_at, window_end_at, username, login_count, first_login_at, last_login_at, calculated_at) VALUES (#{windowStart}, #{windowEnd}, #{stat.username}, #{stat.loginCount}, #{stat.firstLoginAt}, #{stat.lastLoginAt}, #{calculatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE window_end_at = VALUES(window_end_at), login_count = VALUES(login_count), first_login_at = VALUES(first_login_at), last_login_at = VALUES(last_login_at), calculated_at = VALUES(calculated_at)
